title: ACVP DRBG Response
description: Response format for ACVP ctrDRBG test vector processing per the ACVP DRBG specification.

vsId.description: Vector set identifier, must match the vsId from the prompt.

revision.description: Protocol revision, must match the revision from the prompt.

testGroups.description: Array of test group response objects, one per prompt test group.

tgId.description: Test group identifier, must match the tgId from the corresponding prompt group.

tests.description: Array of test case response objects.

tcId.description: Test case identifier, must match the tcId from the corresponding prompt test case.

returnedBits.description: Hex-encoded output bits from the final DRBG generate call. Length must equal returnedBitsLen/4 characters.
